description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
